items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Buddy Johnson was another cat that had a good band too. Do you remember Buddy Johnson?

ctx.x: I heard them a lot. In fact I heard them a whole lot. Because they stayed down in Florida for a while. For quite a while they couldn't even get out of there. Had to stand it in there.
Buddy Johnson was another cat that had a good band too. Do you remember Buddy Johnson?
Yeah, he had a good band but it was more of that commercial type band.
